frequency_question: How often do congressional principals with stated intent to block major executive international agreements successfully enact a joint resolution of disapproval within the statutory window?
membership_rule: Includes formal joint resolutions of disapproval introduced and voted upon under expedited statutory procedures concerning major international nuclear or arms agreements. Excludes non-binding resolutions of disapproval or measures lacking sufficient legislative momentum to reach floor votes.
